name: The Glass Butterfly Conservatory
description: A greenhouse made entirely of stained glass where mechanical butterflies with gemstone wings flutter between crystalline flowers that refract rainbow light across marble floors.
prompt: A stunning conservatory built entirely of stained glass panels in vibrant colors, hundreds of mechanical butterflies with intricate gemstone wings (ruby, emerald, sapphire, diamond) fluttering between crystalline flowers that sparkle and refract rainbow light, marble floors reflecting the kaleidoscope of colors, soft natural light streaming through the glass ceiling, ethereal and elegant atmosphere, highly detailed, fantasy art style
caption: Where every flutter paints the air with rainbows... 🦋✨ Which jewel-wing would you follow?
